scientific_role: Corrected pre-development configuration after the explicitly recorded preflight abort. No completed C4 development outcome existed when this file was frozen.

attributor.ewma_role: diagnostic only; excluded from attribution classification and entry-veto decisions

auxiliary_witness_rule.ordinary_non_candidate_sample: accrue one trusted-history sample when auxiliary evidence remains valid/consistent
auxiliary_witness_rule.raw_c3_candidate_while_latch_inactive: freeze existing trusted-history count; do not accrue or erase it
auxiliary_witness_rule.confirmed_c4_suppression: freeze existing trusted-history count; the veto cannot self-certify auxiliary trust
auxiliary_witness_rule.reset_conditions: hard auxiliary invalidity/nonfinite/out-of-bounds, V3 auxiliary parameter mismatch, V3 auxiliary EWMA inconsistency/startup-unavailable evidence, or an actually accepted/active sensor latch

suppression_evidence_policy.scope: new C3 entry/substitution candidates only; already-accepted C3 latches are never cleared by C4
suppression_evidence_policy.first_confirmed_veto: RESET positive/negative CUSUM and abnormal entry evidence once, keep active false, continue physical feedback
suppression_evidence_policy.continued_affirmative_veto: FREEZE entry evidence at zero while current raw plant/main-mismatch evidence remains affirmative
suppression_evidence_policy.veto_exit: resume the unchanged C3 detector from clean zero entry evidence immediately; skipped residuals are not replayed

immutability_statement: The preflight fix changed only implementation reachability/evidence plumbing. Calibration thresholds, 3/5 persistence, C4 state semantics, go/no-go criteria, and all frozen V3 behavior/evidence are unchanged from the preflight-invalid configuration.

final_holdout_status.selection_condition: select/freeze only if the predeclared development stage gate returns GO
